notes:
锚点骨架双轨 AI 架构 (0.5s 极速响应) + 单语言英英沉浸 + 知识库激活
1. 0.5 秒极速骨架响应与双轨并发呈现：重构 AI 请求管道。阶段一在 0.5 秒内极速吐出 meanings 释义骨架并解锁 UI（本地词库 hit 为 0 毫秒）；随后以此为 Anchor 并发拉起 Lookup 增量细节与 Pure Core 认知，消除卡顿与错位。
2. 长句 1 条忠实译文流转约束：长句子输入时极速骨架严格仅吐出 1 条忠实全文翻译义项，绝不上多条总结。
3. 彻底沉浸式单语言（英英词典）模式：升级单语言模式（Option B）。勾选后，即使输入中文（如“制裁”），AI 定位目标词 sanction 后，所有的含义释义、场景描述、搭配、词根及认知故事 100% 全部用纯英文生成。
4. 单条义项按需 AI 深度赋能：显示 ✨ AI 场景与图片 小按钮，一键并行生成场景解释与 Tavily 搜图词。
5. 用户知识库（记忆库）导师级活化：在长句语法纠错与 AI 问答中自动结合 profileStore 记忆库，提供专属导师提示。

notes_en:
Anchor-Based Multi-Stage Pipeline (0.5s response) + Monolingual Option B + Memory Activation
1. 0.5s Ultra-Fast Meanings Skeleton & Dual-Track Pipeline: Stage 1 delivers meanings skeleton in ~0.5s (0ms for local SQLite hit) to unlock UI immediately. Stage 2 & 3 populate Lookup details and Pure Core concurrently bound to the fixed anchor.
2. Single Faithful Sentence Translation Rule: Sentence input skeleton strictly produces 1 full faithful translation sense.
3. Immersive Monolingual Mode (Option B): When enabled, even for Chinese inputs, AI maps to target English word and generates ALL definitions, scenes, collocations, and stories 100% in English.
4. Single-Meaning AI Enrichment: Added "✨ AI Insights" button to generate scenes & Tavily search queries per meaning on-demand.
5. Personalized Learning Memory Activation: Injected user learning history into sentence/grammar checks for tailored feedback.
